question: What desires and happiness does the supreme hundred-name hymn bestow on practitioners?
premises: The supreme hundred names grant all desires and aims.
The supreme hundred names bring happiness.
These benefits are bestowed upon practitioners.
inference: Therefore the supreme hundred-name hymn fulfills practitioners' desires and confers happiness upon them.
uncertainties: The adjectives are read as qualifying nāma+aṣṭa+śatam from the preceding verse.
plain_english: O goddess, it grants all desires and aims and brings happiness to practitioners.
